rights: Reference screenshots retained for this private design research board; original creators retain their rights. No brand assets are used in NUMEK style frames.

references.title: Hyperbolic / Studio Freight
references.creator: https://studiofreight.com/work/hyperbolic
references.observation: The oversized product sits off the left edge while a narrow right column explains it. On scroll, the same silhouette changes from a white render to violet line detail; the graphic continues into the next section.
references.application: Keep a recognizable analytical object in place as the page reveals its evidence. The subject for NUMEK is the finding/report, not GPU hardware.
references.motion: Observed the render-to-line-detail scroll states. Some media on the creator case study reported playback failure; original-site visuals rendered.
references.status: Live hero and next section inspected; creator case study read.

references.title: Micro / Reform Collective
references.creator: https://www.reformcollective.com/work/micro
references.observation: An edge-framed opening scene gives way to an enormous mask, then a front-facing application preview. A small product-mode strip sits directly above the preview. The reveal has three distinct scales.
references.application: Stage the transition from NUMEK’s proposition into a readable working product. Retain the deliberate framing, not the scenery, spheres or branded mask.
references.motion: Scrolled through opening scene → central mask → application. The initial preload delayed access; no precise easing or performance measurement claimed.
references.status: Live landing sequence and creator case study inspected.

references.title: AI in Design Report 2026 / ++hellohello
references.creator: https://www.hellohello.is/case-studies/stateofai
references.observation: The cover divides a small explanatory column from a dominant title. The Tools chapter reuses this asymmetry for its conclusion and chart, with the source immediately below the visual.
references.application: Carry brand scale into the report without sacrificing chart labels or reading order. Pair conclusions with denominators, source notes and methodology.
references.motion: Observed cover scrolling and navigated to the Tools chapter. The stable column alignment supplies continuity; no chart-hover behavior was tested.
references.status: Live homepage and Tools chapter inspected. The supplied URL currently serves the 2026 edition.

references.title: ART+TECH Report 2023 / MoreSleep
references.creator: https://www.awwwards.com/sites/art-tech-report-2023
references.observation: One saturated field unifies display type and quantitative sections. In the demographic section, interacting with a tile reveals the chart while another tile returns to its label.
references.application: Make evidence disclosure feel intentional and graphically distinctive. NUMEK’s default state must still expose the important conclusion and support keyboard interaction.
references.motion: Clicked the visible gender tile; the bar chart appeared. Cover, demographic section and disclosure states captured.
references.status: Discovered through the Awwwards project page; original site inspected.

references.title: LPAS / Studio Naam
references.creator: https://studionaam.com/projects/lpas/
references.observation: The next subject is already visible as a narrow slice at the edge. Vertical scrolling advances a horizontal sequence of large images and substantial caption blocks; each panel has its own muted field.
references.application: Use partial product views to promise the next analytical layer, and let sections expand into legible software. No architecture imagery or forced horizontal scrolling in the working app.
references.motion: Observed and captured ten sequential scroll frames across category panels. Frame playback shows ordering, not original timing.
references.status: Live opening and multiple category panels inspected; creator page checked.

references.title: Phantom Studios
references.creator: https://www.phantom.land/
references.observation: A spatial wall of work uses fixed edge controls; the bottom-left view switch replaces it with a highly compressed project index. Two presentations serve different levels of scanning.
references.application: Let evidence overview and exact detail be different but connected views. Keep critical navigation in the DOM and avoid curved text or motion in reading mode.
references.motion: Used the grid/list switch. Captured the spatial overview and the entering index state; not a complete project-detail journey.
references.status: Live overview, scroll response and view switch inspected.

references.title: Hamilton / Shirley Wu, The Pudding
references.creator: https://pudding.cool/2017/03/hamilton/
references.observation: Text introduces the meaning of each mark before the visualization groups them. The page explains relationship and filter semantics next to the intended analytical view.
references.application: Teach one visual encoding, then reuse it for investigation. Every mark or connection in DataTrust must correspond to supplied evidence.
references.motion: Observed marks moving from a field toward groups during scrolling. The later filter view remained incompletely rendered, so working filters and tooltip behavior are unverified.
references.status: Partially rendered. Use only the observed explanatory sequencing, not claimed interaction quality.

references.title: Siena Film Foundation / Niccolò Miranda
references.creator: https://siena.film/
references.observation: A distinctive typographic entrance yields to an almost full-viewport subject, with supporting metadata attached to the edges and the next item visible below.
references.application: Give the real product subject presence and distinctive typography. Do not borrow tickets, film texture, festival language or the entry gate.
references.motion: Entered the site and observed the transition to the film presentation. Later navigation and individual film detail were not tested.
references.status: Entry and main presentation inspected; capture includes an in-progress title transition.

references.title: Year in Review 2025 / Unseen Studio
references.creator: https://2025.unseen.co/
references.observation: Display typography occupies offset positions within a textured field. Scrolling pushes the cover sideways and reveals a contrasting next scene.
references.application: Use a decisive change of composition when moving from question to evidence. Preserve semantic order and provide a direct route to the product.
references.motion: Observed the opening lateral scene transition only. No claims about later project interactions or mobile behavior.
references.status: Live opening and first transition inspected.

references.title: Studio Null
references.creator: https://www.madebynull.com/
references.observation: A single central object sits inside a very sparse frame. Opening Info brings readable content forward while the object loses definition behind it.
references.application: Give one product object attention, then let the user’s reading task dominate. NUMEK should use an evidence/report object, not an unrelated sculpture.
references.motion: Opened Info and observed the content layer and softened background. Did not submit the project form.
references.status: Live opening and information disclosure inspected.

references.title: Linear / secondary product reference
references.creator: https://linear.app/
references.observation: The homepage’s app preview demonstrates one concrete working state with a narrow navigation column, strong issue title and quieter contextual information.
references.application: Check density, hierarchy and selected-item clarity. Do not import Linear’s agent workflow, collaboration features or product claims into NUMEK.
references.motion: Scrolled to inspect the product preview. This was the public marketing demo, not an authenticated application review.
references.status: Public product preview only; secondary influence.
